method: Fresh context, normal app, cold cache, no network/CPU throttle, weak tier, adaptation off. First view includes synchronous default-framebuffer pixel readback after the first-toy-frame signal; frame intervals are actual postrender draws completed by readPixels, with forced rendering. Audio off; one real action after the idle window. Heap is a live JS heap snapshot, not total process/GPU memory. Local HTTP transfer is not public-site compressed transfer.
